body:
## Get to Know Me

Outside of work, I make [music](https://open.spotify.com/artist/6KnbNwkGBiAo9ERQoHT2Yr?si=2fcc9c9c068a4273) and have a [clothing brand](https://pidge.store/). You can see a preview of both below. If I don't create, I'm dying inside.

### Things I like

- Pigeons
- GREAT coffee
- East London

### Things I don't like

- Streamers
- Queueing
- Coffee Shop Squatters
